actor.description: His mushroom cloud of beard hair is powdered with all the abrasions of the trash sea: white lime, red iron, gold filament, opalescent shavings of the plastiglomerate. Chrome joints and pieces of scrap crystal are hooked to pockets lining his torso, and one of his bushy eyebrows is perpetually cocked, though whether that's a symptom of an insatiable curiosity or forehead mutation is unknown.

registration.method: Integer translation of body, head and masks together; no rescale or independent silhouette centering.
registration.native_acceptance: Deferred until all conversions are generated.

assembly_contract.geometry: Original body/head and full item pixels retained; only composition and late ownership applied. No rescale or position change.
assembly_contract.ownership: Body first, source-declared far-hand gear behind body, worn vest/footwear/monocle in disjoint regions, near-hand gear above outfit. Each item applies only its own body-overlay alpha at composition; no full-body redraw above other equipment.
assembly_contract.color: Captured body c; actual item TileColor overrides foreground; independent per-item primary/detail. One coverage for primary/detail within item, no copied whole-outfit body tint.
assembly_contract.weapon_pose: Existing stationary authoring display fits only; no ready/drafted/resting acceptance claimed. Authoritative spec assigns item-specific grip/angle/depth/native pose review to integrated Stage3 after all-generation gate; no new Qud drafting mechanic.
assembly_contract.native_visibility: Hidden previews show no actor layers; native visibility/hurt/look/save and held-state behavior remain untested behind full-generation gate.

cosmetic_boundary: Per authoritative A4/user scope, hair/eyes/beards/personal overlays postponed beyond initial conversion. Argyve beard/eyebrow/scrap description retained, not baked into shared body or fabricated as equipment.
native_acceptance: Pending integrated Stage3 after all156generation entries: actual visibility/equip-unequip/near-far hand/resting-ready/hurt/look/save-load. This packet is authoring only.
